Zoning Permit Application City of Stanton Planning & Zoning P.O. Box 370 - Stanton, Kentucky 40380 stantonky.gov/planning - and - zoning (606) 663 - 6474 What is required to obtain a Zoning Permit? (per Zoning Ordinance Article III Section 320) 1) Signed/completed application form and method of payment for appropriate permit fee. 2) Site plan: drawn to scale with lot dimensions, outside dimensions of all structures to be constructed or altered, and all existing structures, use of structures, yard depths, and any other information necessary for determining compliance with the Zoning Ordinance. 3) Floodplain compliance if applicable. 4) Additional for Signs: Elevation drawing drawn to scale showing sign dimensions and overall height. 5) Certificate of Occupancy : A fter construction activity is complete , issued after final inspection. Box 370 - Stanton, Kentucky 40380 www.stantonky.gov (606) 663-6474 Definitions Mobile Food Vehicle - A vehicle-mounted, vehicle-towed, or vehicle-carried food service establishment that engages in the sale and preparation of food or beverages to the public. Mobile Food Vendor - A person or legal entity that prepares or serves food or beverages to the public from a Mobile Food Vehicle. Restaurant Tax All Extended-Term and Short-Term Vendors shall be responsible for payment of the Restaurant Tax in the amount of 3% of all sales occurring in the City limits of Stanton to the City of Stanton. Sales of Alcohol Prohibited Mobile Food Vehicles are not authorized or permitted to sell alcohol in the city limits of Stanton.
